name: Devour
source:
Your mom sends you off to collect some mushrooms from the local forest with the usual warning: “Be careful of Devourers!” Not that anything exciting like that could ever happen to you.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
妈妈派你去附近的森林里采些蘑菇，临走前照例叮嘱了一句：“当心吞噬者！”不过话说回来，那种刺激的事怎么可能落到你头上呢。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
